Name: Spouse Stuff
Author: hquake
Description:
Makes it possible to interact with your spouse's stuff in your house when you are married.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Get married! After marriage your house contains a section next to the bedroom containing your spouse's beloved possessions. Go to them and interact with them like you would any other object!

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 beta and above on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, may not work as intended in multiplayer (not presently supported, but shouldn't break the game),
[*]Will not work as expected when used alongside mods that change the layout of the farmhouse.
[/list]
